record.excerpt: A base order fires when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 … Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (−2%, −5%, −9.5%, −16%, −25%) with 1.8× size scaling per rung. … Take Profit: 3% above average entry. … Stop Loss: None — ladder allocation is the structural risk cap. … Net Profit: +5,790.33 USDT (+5.79%) … Percent Profitable: 68.82% (64 / 93) … Profit Factor: 5.019 … Test Period: January 1, 2024 — June 28, 2026 (~30 months).

spec.claim_summary: A long averaging strategy enters when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 and uses five downside averaging orders with 1.8x sizing to target 3% above average entry.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical single-position rule can replicate the five-rung averaging ladder with 1.8x sizing and average-entry take-profit that defines entries, exits and risk.
assumptions: Asset not named in claim; ETHUSDT chosen as most natural reading because the page is about ETH.
Direction assumed long: fixed negative averaging deviations and take-profit above average entry imply dip-buy long; claim never states long or short.
Entry phrase 'drops below 28' compiled as crosses_below 28 rather than holding below 28.
No stop-loss encoded because claim states 'Stop Loss: None'.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging/DCA orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% with 1.8x size scaling per rung and 3% take-profit above average entry price; this ladder defines entries, exits and risk and is the heart of the strategy.
